site.sitedescription: Mature karst doline. Physiography: Kaibab Plateau. Surrounding vegetation: Pinus ponderosa, Pseudotsuga menziesii, with sparse Abies concolor. Picea engelmannii, P, pungens, and Populus tremuloides line the meadow edges.
